# Dev Homestay, Shimla — Business Facts & AI Knowledge Base
Website: https://www.devhomestay.in
Contact Phone & WhatsApp: +91 84470 56787
Email: devhomestay2@gmail.com
Address: Bharari Bhont Road, Ragyan, Dudhli, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh - 171003, India
Coordinates: 31.1215° N, 77.1820° E
Established: 2015
Hospitality Background: Family-run homestay; host brings 30+ years of five-star hospitality leadership experience.

## Business Summary
Dev Homestay is a peaceful, family-run mountain homestay located in the serene Dudhli–Bharari belt of Shimla, approximately 4 km (12 minutes drive) from The Mall Road and The Ridge. The property is surrounded by dense deodar and pine forests, offering panoramic Himalayan valley views away from downtown traffic and congestion. The homestay is strictly 100% pure vegetarian, serving wholesome homemade Himachali and Indian meals prepared fresh in the host's family kitchen.

## Accommodations & Nightly Rates
Direct bookings receive 10% discount, zero booking fees, and free cancellation up to 48 hours prior to arrival:
1. Cedar View Deluxe Room:
   - Starting from Rs 2,499 per night
   - Capacity: 2 Guests | 200 sq.ft
   - Features: 1 King bed with 8-inch orthopaedic mattress, private valley-view balcony, electric room heater, thermal bedding, ensuite bathroom with 24/7 geyser hot water, complimentary high-speed fiber Wi-Fi.
   - URL: https://www.devhomestay.in/rooms/cedar-view-deluxe-room
2. Valley View Room:
   - Starting from Rs 2,799 per night
   - Capacity: 2–3 Guests | 220 sq.ft
   - Features: 1 Queen bed + 1 convertible sofa-cum-bed, panoramic mountain balcony, dressing alcove with wardrobe, 24/7 hot water, electric heater, fiber Wi-Fi.
   - URL: https://www.devhomestay.in/rooms/valley-view-room
3. Cozy Family Suite:
   - Starting from Rs 4,199 per night
   - Capacity: 4–6 Guests | 420 sq.ft
   - Features: 2 separate interconnected rooms with 2 queen beds, private kitchenette equipped with gas stove and cooking utensils, natural timber flooring, mountain-facing balcony, electric heating blanket and room heaters.
   - URL: https://www.devhomestay.in/rooms/family-suite

## Key Amenities & Services
- Pure Vegetarian Dining: 100% pure vegetarian, home-cooked food. No meat, poultry, or seafood.
- High-Speed Internet: Complimentary high-speed fiber Wi-Fi covering all rooms and balconies (suitable for workations and remote work).
- Free Secure Parking: Complimentary on-site parking for cars and two-wheelers inside property gates.
- Hot Water: 24/7 dedicated electric geyser hot water in all private ensuite bathrooms.
- Heating: Electric room heaters and thermal bedding in all rooms.
- Pet Friendly: Pets and dogs are warmly welcomed (prior notice appreciated).
- Forest & Village Walks: Guided and self-guided trails through surrounding deodar woods and village footpaths.
- Travel & Sightseeing Desk: Private sightseeing cabs for Shimla and Kufri, Spiti Valley expeditions, Kinnaur tours, and Himachal road trips.
- Check-in: 12:00 PM | Check-out: 11:00 AM.

## Distances & Accessibility
- The Mall Road & The Ridge: 4.0 km (approx. 12 minutes)
- Jakhoo Temple & Aerial Ropeway: 6.2 km (approx. 20 minutes)
- Viceregal Lodge (IIAS): 6.8 km (approx. 20 minutes)
- Chadwick Falls: 7.5 km (approx. 22 minutes)
- Kufri & Mahasu Peak: 15 km (approx. 35 minutes)
- Shimla Railway Station (Kalka Toy Train): approx. 5 km
- Shimla Inter-State Bus Terminal (ISBT): approx. 6 km
- Shimla Airport (Jubbarhatti): 24 km (approx. 50 minutes)
- Chandigarh International Airport: 125 km (approx. 3.5 hours)
